create_TrainingSampler: create a TrainingSampler to produce an infinite stream of shuffled training indices across distributed workers
create_RandomSubsetTrainingSampler: create a RandomSubsetTrainingSampler to sample a random subset of training indices for accuracy estimation
create_RepeatFactorTrainingSampler: create a RepeatFactorTrainingSampler to handle class-imbalanced datasets with repeat factors based on category frequency
create_InferenceSampler: create an InferenceSampler to split inference indices evenly across all distributed workers
build_repeat_factors_from_category_frequ: build repeat factors from category frequency for class-imbalanced datasets like LVIS
